name: openk8s-desktop
description: App desktop local-first (alternative à Lens) : multi-cluster Kubernetes. Stack Wails + Go + client-go (backend) / React + TS + Tailwind + shadcn/ui (frontend). Étapes 1-4 du MVP : connexion kubeconfig (collé/local), exploration des ressources, expérience pod (détail, logs streaming, terminal, port-forward, events, YAML), détail deployment (scale + logs agrégés).

stack.frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui + TanStack Query + Zustand + react-router v8 + CodeMirror 6 + xterm.js + i18next

architecture: Wails desktop (backend Go embarqué + frontend React). Deux flux : bindings (req/resp) + runtime.EventsEmit (streaming logs/terminal/port-forward).
